title: Pokemon TCG Palkia Celebrations Classic Collection 004/025 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Palkia 004/025 Celebrations Holo Rare Pokemon Card is a must-have for any collector or fan of the Pokemon TCG. With its stunning holo finish and intricate details, this card is sure to impress. The card features Palkia, a Water-type Beast-Warrior creature, and is a part of the Base Set, Collector's Edition, 1st Edition, and Chase features.

Made of high-quality card stock, this standard-sized card is perfect for display or use in battles. The card is in English language and manufactured by Nintendo in the United States. It is suitable for ages 6 and up and is not autographed. Add this card to your collection today and catch 'em all!
